assertions.subject: Cyanotic congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: Cyanosis, the visible sign of this shunt, occurs when approximately 5 g/100 mL of reduced hemoglobin is present in systemic blood

assertions.subject: Cyanotic congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: Cyanotic congenital heart disease occurs when some of the systemic venous return crosses from the right side of the heart to the left and returns to the body without going through the lungs (righttoleft shunt)

assertions.subject: Cyanotic congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: Thus, a polycythemic patient appears cyanotic with a lower percentage of reduced hemoglobin

assertions.subject: Cyanotic congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: A patient with anemia requires a higher percentage of reduced hemoglobin for the recognition of cyanosis
